facts.fact: The Data Protection Act, 2024 (Act No. 3 of 2024) was passed in Parliament on 7 December 2023, assented by the President on 31 January 2024 and published on 2 February 2024; section 1 brings it into operation on a date the Minister appoints by Gazette notice, and the document names no commencement date.

Section 4 designates the Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority as the Data Protection Authority, to act independently of any person's direction; the document records no appointment of members or start of operations as the authority under the Act.
